title: Error body
description: The body of every non-2xx answer from a publish-v1 route (OpenPairings and Alnasl both read it). Dispatch on `error`; `detail` is an English sentence for logs and may be reworded at any time. The HTTP status for each code is fixed (see docs/public-publishing.md, "Error bodies"). Two answers are NOT this shape: a route this server does not have (Phoenix's own 404, no `error` code - an OpenResults too old for the route), and a body over the parser's size limit (413 from Plug.Parsers). A 429 and storage_low also carry a Retry-After header.
